section.title: Overview
section.para: An application that uses the built-in OpenNLP components and loads its models from files or streams can be compiled into a GraalVM native image. Add org.apache.opennlp.addons:native-image as a dependency; the image builder picks up the reachability metadata in its jar. No other configuration is needed.

Core creates tool factories, artifact serializers, feature generator factories, sequence codecs, string interners, trainers, model readers and writers by the class name a model manifest, a feature descriptor or the training parameters give, and the model resolver creates model classes by type. The metadata registers the constructors these lookups use, the Snowball routines the Finnish and Indonesian stemmers find through method handles, and the bundled resources core reads by a computed name, such as the stopword list of a language. It covers opennlp-api, opennlp-runtime and the opennlp-ml-* modules.

The metadata is generated from the core jars by ReachabilityMetadataGenerator, and ReachabilityMetadataTest fails when the shipped file no longer matches the core version the add-on builds against, or when the runtime jar bundles a resource no glob covers. Like the other add-ons, the module tracks the core 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and the metadata is regenerated when core changes.

section.title: Building an image
section.para: Build the image with the GraalVM Maven plugin or with native-image directly, on a GraalVM JDK 25 or later. Load models from files or streams:

NativeSmoke in this add-on is a minimal native application. It loads the sentence detector, tokenizer, POS tagger and person name finder models from a directory and checks each result. The native profile builds and runs it:

listitem.para: Class path scanning for models (SimpleClassPathModelFinder, ClassgraphModelFinder) is not supported in an image. Load models from files or streams.
Java serialization of models is not supported in an image. Use the model's own serialize(OutputStream) and InputStream constructor.
opennlp-dl, the ONNX Runtime and opennlp-cli are out of scope.

A custom factory, serializer, feature generator or trainer that a model names needs its no-argument constructor in the application's own reflection metadata, the same way this add-on registers the built-in ones.
